log.msg: bug found+fixed: band descent used the VISIBLE child count to decide 'single-child wrapper', but a lazily-shown tab panel reports checkVisibility()=false at scan time while still being a real sibling — that made every page read bands:0. Fixed: branch on the raw (unfiltered) child count, filter for visibility only when building the reported list.

bug found+fixed: `display:contents` wrapper (core/Page's nested-page shape, readme: 'nested pages ARE peers via display: contents') generates no box of its own, so checkVisibility() is correctly false for it even though its children are on screen. Fixed: expand any display:contents child into its own children before counting/collecting bands.

bug found+fixed: the wraps heuristic (height > 1.6x line-height) flagged every .ui-tree-row in the sidebar as '1.8 lines' at every width, on rows a screenshot check showed were plainly single-line text — the row's PADDING (a comfortable click target), not wrapping, was inflating the border-box height. Fixed: subtract padding+border before comparing to line-height. Proof re-run confirms: sidebar rows dropped out of every page's wraps list, only two genuinely two-line icon+label drawer-rail buttons remain.
